lessonTitle: 42. The area of a spherical zone
lessonTitleEnglish: The area of a spherical zone
unit: Geometry · Chapter 9. Volumes and surfaces of solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: A spherical zone is the part of a sphere between two parallel planes; its area is S = 2πRh, h the distance between the planes.
stages.headlineEnglish: A spherical zone is the part of a sphere between two parallel planes; its area is S = 2πRh, h the distance between the planes.

stages.headline: A spherical cap also has area 2πRh; by Archimedes a zone has the same area as the band of the circumscribed cylinder of the same height.
stages.headlineEnglish: A spherical cap also has area 2πRh; by Archimedes a zone has the same area as the band of the circumscribed cylinder of the same height.

stages.headline: Example: R = 5, h = 2 give S = 20π; for a hemisphere h = R and S = 2πR².
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: R = 5, h = 2 give S = 20π; for a hemisphere h = R and S = 2πR².
